mechanism: Polyethylene glycol (PEG) bowel preparation can reduce vancomycin absorption and efficacy when used orally for C. difficile infection by increasing GI transit time and diluting drug concentration in the colon.
action: Separate vancomycin oral administration from PEG bowel prep by at least 2-4 hours; consider alternative bowel preparation methods if vancomycin treatment for CDI is concurrent.
